reviews.text:
Kind, helpful, empathetic doctors and staff who treat my cats in the best possible way.
I am grateful to them, great team.. 🐈🥰
We have been coming here for years, excellent care, very kind doctors. Used to be a guinea pig, with our pet cat for over 13 years.

They are very nice and know what they are doing. We will be happy to come again from now on.
Thank you for your help.

We have been going to this clinic for many years and my puppy has ALWAYS received perfect care. Everyone is kind, animal-loving, you feel like they live exclusively for them. They pay attention to each and every animal as if it were their own, it totally touches me. I would like to thank the entire team for their work, they are irreplaceable. I would single them all out, but most of the times we have been to Dr. Herth Laszó over the years and I honestly couldn't imagine a better doctor than him. I could always contact him outside of work, and he even called me to check on my puppy's health. I can't thank him enough!

I can't believe I haven't written a review yet, even though we've been going here for 18 years now with our third dog! :) I can only say the best, they're a very kind, empathetic, knowledgeable team, it's obvious they love animals. :) A few years ago, the doctor came to our house when our Labrador's ears needed treatment and we couldn't take him to the clinic. He came every week and cleaned and treated his ears until he was completely fine. Our slightly aggressive, distrustful dog ate from his palm, ignored the treatment, and almost unpacked his bag out of gratitude. :D
I can only recommend the clinic!
They are kind and attentive to their little patients.

We are extremely grateful to the entire team at the clinic! Our cat needed an emergency operation, and it was done in a weakened state, but the procedure was successful, and they treated her with the utmost care, expertise, and humanity.

They informed us in detail about everything, and we felt that the fate of the animals was really important to them. We can thank them for the fact that our cat can still be with us today. We recommend them wholeheartedly to everyone! 🐾❤️

I have been taking my puppy here for years and we always receive the utmost attention, kindness and expertise. The doctor and his assistants are always patient, attentive and it is obvious that they love animals from the bottom of their hearts. I am grateful to have my pet in such reliable hands! 🐾💚 …
Great doctors. I can only recommend them. They always treated my old cat with love and expertise. Thanks to them, my old tabby lived for 20 years.
The team we met was fast, kind, and helpful. I recommend them to anyone who wants competent, kind care!

We use the clinic's services with two rabbits and a rescued kitten. We received emergency help over the phone if necessary, but an appointment is also available quickly if needed. Animal-loving, great team, friendly prices.

Very nice, professional dog and owner friendly place!
We have only good experiences!!
Polite and helpful team, Dr. Herth's professional and human attitude is exemplary.

I called before the office hours to say that there was a problem with my dog's eye, and I had an appointment in an hour. The doctor was incredibly fantastic. She did her job very professionally, even though she had a 2 cm cataract in her eye, quite deep. She removed the cataract very kindly, patiently and very quickly. Moreover, without anesthesia. We are very grateful to her. Thank you for the quick and professional help ❤️Our rating is 10/10⭐❤️
Conscientious doctors, professional care.
Very well equipped and professional, with a surprisingly kind doctor and reasonable prices.
They weren't really nice.

Correct, communicative, helpful, friendly doctor, doctor and assistant.😁 I'm not saying that they are good in terms of prices, because everyone would go there.
Damn! 🫣 I said it myself!😅 …
They are very precise, thorough, and kind. We love coming here.
They always treat our cat kindly and professionally.
Everyone was very kind and helpful, no matter when we went. To describe it in a few words: maximum patience, understanding, professional, expert care! Thank you very much!

Many years ago we were looking for a reliable veterinary clinic for our found dog. This place, reminiscent of a gingerbread house, seemed nice
. The staff there seemed kind, polite, knowledgeable, and animal-friendly. We went to them with Pajti for more than 16 years. They always treated and cured him kindly and patiently. We said goodbye to him together.

We can go by appointment, so the long wait can be avoided.

Our family has grown with two kittens, and we chose the doctor and his team on Pálya Street again.
I feel we made the right decision. They helped us a lot to overcome a serious illness. Thank you!🍀
We went for puppy vaccinations. A very thorough examination was performed, we received a lot of useful information, in a nice, friendly atmosphere. We will come here again next time.

I went to the clinic with my cats on Monday, a doctor and two of her colleagues took care of us. They took care of my cats with great competence and loving kindness. The care of the cats did not cost as much as the superficial care of a cat at a vet who came to the house last time. I am very, very satisfied, because both cats improved a lot from the recommended treatments. Before this, we were at the doctor's office before the examination, he didn't understand it now, but it turned out that both of them understand their job very well. Halfway home, I thought how good it would be if there was such a mentality and competence in the healthcare that treats people. Thank you
They are lovely. I can only recommend them.
